issues: Latent bug: featurize() silently drops molecules whose SMILES fail to parse (the `if mol:` branch has no else). If any input failed, feature rows would misalign with train_y and fit_predict would return fewer probabilities than test molecules. Both candidate runs completed with no integrity flags, so all 1624 molecules evidently parse and the measured loss is unaffected; still, a zero-vector fallback or an explicit error would be safer.
No measurement circumvention: no file or network access, no pasted answers, test labels not used. The change only appends 167 MACCS bits to the Morgan count fingerprint.

Recomputed z agrees with the harness: candidate mean (0.1087+0.1030)/2 = 0.10585, gain vs incumbent 0.1150 is 0.00915, SE = 0.0049*sqrt(1/2+1/1) = 0.00600, z = 1.52 (harness reported 1.517). Marginal evidence from 2 candidate runs vs 1 incumbent run; a replicate would firm it up.
